name.ja: 鬼滅模型 竈門禰豆子

description.ja: 『鬼滅の刃』より、プラモデル初心者でも簡単に組み立てられる「鬼滅模型」に竈門炭治郎の妹、竈門禰豆子がラインアップ！
description.en: From "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba ", Tanjiro Kamado's younger sister, Nezuko Kamado, is now available as a " Demon Slayer" model that can be easily assembled even by plastic model beginners!

description.ja: ■着物の柄やシワに至るまで、こだわりの造形表現で立体化。
description.en: • Even the pattern and wrinkles of the kimono have been sculpted into three-dimensional detail.

description.ja: ■目や眉はライトユーザーでも安心なタンポ印刷で再現。
description.en: • Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced with tampo printing that is safe even for light users.

description.ja: ■髪の“うねり”や“なびき”の様子をパーツ分割により立体的に表現。毛先の色分けは塗装済パーツにより再現している｡
description.en: • The “undulations” and “fluttering” of hair are expressed in three dimensions by dividing the parts. The color coding of the tips of the hair is reproduced using painted parts.

description.ja: ■「鬼滅模型 竈門炭治郎」(別売り)と並べてディスプレイすることで劇中のイメージを演出。
description.en: • Create an image from the play by displaying it alongside "Demon Slayer Model Kamado Tanjiro" (sold separately).
